summary: Full backend + frontend validation for AudioGen (ElevenLabs Flash v2.5), central pricing system, and image prompt limit expansion (500→1000). 12/12 backend pytest checks pass. All 6 frontend flow checks pass. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY intentionally absent → endpoint returns 503 pt-BR, no reservation created, no secret value leaked. /api/pricing snapshot matches spec exactly. /api/me/usage exposes audio_* fields. Image validation enforces min=3 / max=1000. Frontend AudioGenPage renders, char counter + segundos estimated shown, error surfaces in data-testid=audio_gen-error, ImageGenPage char counter now shows N/1000.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~920 lines — consider splitting audio/image/subscription routers into modules (nice-to-have, not blocking).
In /api/generate-audio the pre-validation branch at line ~496 uses 'if False else ...' — dead ternary; can be simplified to a plain string HTTPException detail.

Race protection uses insert+recheck+delete pattern which works, but under high concurrency a tiny window can over-commit. Consider atomic aggregate+conditional insert or a mongo transaction if load grows.
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY name appears in 503 message — this is INTENTIONAL per spec (only the name, never the value) and confirmed by test.
Frontend AudioGenPage: `remainingSec.toFixed?.(0) ?? remainingSec` — remainingSec is always a Number so `?.` on toFixed is redundant; also called twice inline. Minor readability.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testes cobrem 12 casos: root, /api/pricing snapshot (todos os valores esperados + ausência de segredos), /api/me/usage (anonymous + auth com campos audio_*), POST /api/generate-audio (503 sem key + no reservation drift, empty text 422, no JWT 401, 3001+ chars 413/422), /api/generate-image validation (min 3, max 1000, 999 aceito), login admin. Sem ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, o fluxo positivo de áudio é INTESTÁVEL — o admin do produto vai configurar via Emergent Secrets. Frontend valida audio_gen card visível na Home (agora 6 tools em Mais usadas), navegação /ferramenta/audio_gen, textarea+counter+estimativa em segundos, erro pt-BR renderizado em data-testid=audio_gen-error, e image_gen char counter atualizado para /1000.
